title: 第12章 师傅的过去第13章 李万生就是弱点？

第一卷 重生归来 第十二章 师傅的过去
天玑子的这个能力，让苏芮不得不在心中给他点三十二个赞。简直就是一大杀器呀，好人坏人一目了然，不过还有什么功能，就需要她自己发掘了。
异能什么的可以慢慢来探索，反正她有的是时间不是么。不过现在倒是可以拿师傅实验一下。
苏芮小会呢。
突然，一阵饭菜的香味传来，苏芮匆匆跑到厨房，正好看到柳青云将最后一道菜炒好，立马狗腿的上前接过菜，端到饭厅。
苏芮心虚的吃着饭。柳青云见状，开口道“明早五点起来和为师练功，上午修习书法，下午你自行分配。”
“弟子明白。”苏芮如释重负。
突然想起要用自家师傅做实验的，苏芮暗暗运转功法，只见她一道紫金色的气体从心脏发出到达她的双眼，苏芮脑海中闪现出一个个画面。从柳青云的出生到现在，就像放电影一样。让苏芮惊奇不已。
更让人惊奇的是，这位鹤发童颜，精神矍铄的老人居然都快一百岁了？！如果别人知道了或许会认为柳青云吃了什么仙丹妙药，毕竟长命百岁是每个人都渴望的。不过苏芮却知道这是那本心法的作用。
师傅给她的那本心法虽然和苏芮这种人形修炼机差远了，但是对别人来说可是真正的宝贝。
因为吸收天地元气就有排除身体中的杂质的作用，杂质少了人自然就少生病了，每个细胞经过天地元气的洗涤，就算一百多岁也很有活性，身体机能自然也就持续在巅峰状态。
原来，柳青云出生在一个乡绅家庭，在当地算是有些名望，他的父亲特别想要儿子，但是他的原配夫人给他连着生了三个孩子，都是女儿，而他的夫人呢，在生第三个女儿的时候产后大出血，死了。
所以他就又娶了好几房妾室，想让那几个妾给他生个儿子。并且许诺，谁要能给他生出儿子来，他就让谁当她的妻子，生的儿子呢，就继承他的全部财产。
皇天不负有心人，终于有人怀孕了，而且还是两个人。而且让经验老道的产婆来看，都说是儿子。
乡绅高兴啊，盼了多年的儿子终于来了，一来还是两个。这能不高兴嘛。可是有的人不高兴了，谁不高兴呢？当然是那两个妾了。到手的鸭子就要飞了，怎么能甘心。所以这两个人是处处争风吃醋。
虽然对于男人来说有女的为你吃醋那是很骄傲的事情，可是这两个女人肚子里可是有他宝贝儿子的啊。她们要是为了争风吃醋出了什么事伤到他的儿子怎么办？
所以，这个乡绅为了宝贝儿子们，对两个妾许诺，如果都是儿子那就让她们两个都做妻子。
这下两人消停了，因为她们也知道，她们要得到妻子的位置就要靠肚子里的儿子了，如果儿子没了那就竹篮打水一场空了，还是安心养胎吧。
不过这是柳青云母亲的想法，另一个妾可不甘心就这么算了，毕竟财产只有一份，两个儿子还需要分出去一半。本来都应该是她儿子的，凭什么要分给别人。
所以她就买通了柳青云母亲身边的丫头和产婆，来了个偷龙转凤！把柳青云和外面买来的女婴调换，从儿子就变成了女儿。

而柳青云呢，本来应该被丫头灭口的，不过那个丫头还有点良知，就把他放在官道上，能不能活下来，就看他的命了。
柳青云的命的确好，因为他遇到了他的师傅柳明智，也就是苏芮的师公。
当时柳明智感受到天道的指引，捡到了一个男婴。看到这个男婴，他就知道，这就是他的徒弟了。柳明智以前是个道士，道士是没有妻子和孩子的，所以他用自己的姓氏给他取了名字，叫做柳青云，希望他“不坠青云志自强”，做个有志之士。
柳明智将他养大，教导他知识，让他学习天玑门的心法。为了提升柳青云的心性和眼界，柳明智带着他四处云游。从灯红酒绿的上海滩，到地广人稀的高原。从风景秀丽的云南大理，到工业发达的欧洲列国。所到之处，民风各异，有饥寒交迫的贫民，也有高贵优雅的贵族。游历之后，他们回到了京城。最后定居在京城中，潜心修习各种知识。也就是那个时候，柳明智吩咐柳青云将恭亲王府捐了出去。
直到柳明智去世，柳青云都没有离开过他。
124岁的柳明智去世之后，柳青云便向西云游，来到了老树村停下，等待天命者。然后就遇到了苏芮，并且收她为徒。
苏芮无法看清柳青云的未来，因为柳青云和她的羁绊太深，师徒情紧次于父母、儿女之情。
苏芮也算豁达，看不到就看不到呗，师傅现在才94岁，师公一百二十多岁去世，而师傅怎么也得在活几十年吧，她一点也不担心。
虽然柳青云的过去有九十多年，但是苏芮看完也就几秒钟而已，所以柳青云看到自家徒弟呆愣愣的也没察觉到什么。
第二天一大早，虽然苏芮睡觉也能修炼，但是她还是起床了，当她来到前院，就看到师傅已经盘腿坐在了蒲团上，旁边还有一个蒲团，估计是给她准备的，她快步走过去，学着师傅的样子，盘腿坐在蒲团上，双手一上一下，放在腹部。
当太阳升起的那一刻，不用苏芮催动功法，紫金气体从四面八方涌来，冲进苏芮的身体中，自动运转起来。
感受到空气中的涌动，柳青云暗暗自豪，不愧是我徒弟，资质不要太好哦。
吃过早饭之后，苏芮和柳青云来到书房，柳青云扔给苏芮一本字帖，让她临摹并且吩咐每天要写一千个大字，就背手离开了书房。苏芮只能开始了她的苦逼的写大字之旅。不过当她发现写大字时能让她吸收一丝丝紫金色气体的时候，对于写大字一点怨言也没有了，毕竟蚊子再小也是肉嘛。

Volume 1: Rebirth and Return Chapter 12: Master’s Past
This ability of Tianjizi made Su Rui have to give him thirty-two thumbs up in her heart. It was simply a killer weapon. The good guys and bad guys were obvious at a glance, but she needed to discover what other functions it had.
She can explore things slowly, since she has plenty of time, right? But now I can experiment with the master.
Su Rui Xiaohui.
Suddenly, the smell of food came. Su Rui hurried to the kitchen, just in time to see Liu Qingyun frying the last dish. He immediately stepped forward to take the dish and brought it to the dining room.
Su Rui ate her meal with a guilty conscience. Seeing this, Liu Qingyun said, "Get up at five o'clock tomorrow morning to practice with my teacher. I will practice calligraphy in the morning and you will make your own arrangements in the afternoon."
"Disciple understands." Su Rui felt relieved.
Suddenly remembering that she wanted to use her master for an experiment, Su Rui secretly ran the technique. She saw a purple-gold gas coming from her heart and reaching her eyes. Pictures flashed in Su Rui's mind. From Liu Qingyun's birth to now, it's like watching a movie. Su Rui was surprised.
What's even more surprising is that this old man with gray hair and a childish face and a strong spirit is actually almost a hundred years old? ! If others knew about it, they might think that Liu Qingyun had taken some magic elixir. After all, living a long life is what everyone desires. But Su Rui knew that this was the function of that mental method.
Although the mental method the master gave her was far from a humanoid training machine like Su Rui, it was a real treasure to others.
Because absorbing the vitality of heaven and earth has the effect of eliminating impurities from the body, if there are fewer impurities, people will naturally become less sick. After every cell has been washed by the vitality of heaven and earth, it will still be very active even if it is more than a hundred years old, and the body's functions will naturally continue to be at their peak.
It turned out that Liu Qingyun was born in a squire family and was somewhat famous in the local area. His father wanted a son very much, but his first wife gave him three children in succession, all daughters. And his wife suffered from postpartum hemorrhage when giving birth to the third daughter and died.
So he married several more concubines, hoping that those concubines would give him a son. She also promised that whoever could give him a son would be his wife, and the son would inherit all his property.
Huangtian paid off, someone was finally pregnant, and there were two of them. And when experienced midwives came to see it, they all said it was a son.
The squire was so happy that the sons he had been waiting for for so many years were finally here, two at a time. How can I not be happy about this? But some people are unhappy, and who is unhappy? Of course it was the two concubines. The duck you got is about to fly away, how can you be willing to do so. So these two people are always jealous.
Although it is a very proud thing for a man to have a woman jealous of you, these two women have his precious sons in their bellies. What if something happens to them and hurts his son because of their jealousy?
Therefore, for the sake of his precious sons, the squire promised his two concubines that if they were both sons, he would make them both wives.
The two of them stopped talking now, because they also knew that if they wanted to get the position of wife, they would have to rely on the son in their belly. If the son was gone, it would be all in vain, so they might as well settle down and raise the baby.
But this was Liu Qingyun's mother's idea. The other concubine was not willing to let it go. After all, there was only one share of the property, and half of it had to be divided between the two sons. It should all belong to her son, why should it be given to others.
So she bribed the maids and midwives around Liu Qingyun's mother, and she stole the dragon and turned it into a phoenix! By exchanging Liu Qingyun with the baby girl bought from outside, he changed from a son to a daughter.
As for Liu Qingyun, he should have been silenced by the girl, but that girl still had some conscience, so she put him on the official path. Whether he could survive or not depended on his life.
Liu Qingyun’s life is indeed good, because he met his master Liu Mingzhi, who was Su Rui's master.
At that time, Liu Mingzhi felt the guidance of heaven and picked up a baby boy. When he saw this baby boy, he knew that this was his apprentice. Liu Mingzhi used to be a Taoist priest. Taoist priests have no wives or children, so he named him Liu Qingyun after his own surname, hoping that he would "not fall into the clouds and strive for self-improvement" and become a man of lofty ideals.
Liu Mingzhi raised him, taught him knowledge, and let him learn the mentality of Tianji Sect. In order to improve Liu Qingyun's character and vision, Liu Mingzhi took him around. From the bustling Shanghai beach to the sparsely populated plateau. From the beautiful Dali, Yunnan, to the industrially developed European countries. Wherever he went, the folk customs were different, including poor people who were hungry and cold, and noble and elegant nobles. After traveling, they returned to the capital. Finally, he settled in the capital and devoted himself to studying all kinds of knowledge. It was at that time that Liu Mingzhi ordered Liu Qingyun to donate Prince Gong's palace.
Until Liu Mingzhi's death, Liu Qingyun never left him.
After the death of Liu Mingzhi at the age of 124, Liu Qingyun traveled westward and stopped at Laoshu Village to wait for his destiny. Then he met Su Rui and accepted her as his disciple.
Su Rui could not see Liu Qingyun's future clearly because the bond between Liu Qingyun and her was too deep, and the relationship between master and apprentice was second only to the relationship between parents and children.
Su Rui is also open-minded. If you can't see it, you can't see it. The master is only 94 years old now. He passed away when he was more than 120 years old. However, the master must live for decades. She is not worried at all.
Although Liu Qingyun's past spanned more than ninety years, Su Rui only saw it for a few seconds, so Liu Qingyun didn't notice anything when he saw his apprentice stunned.
Early the next morning, although Su Rui could practice while sleeping, she still got up. When she came to the front yard, she saw that the master was sitting cross-legged on the futon. There was a futon next to it, which was probably prepared for her. She walked over quickly, followed the master's example, and sat cross-legged on the futon, moving her hands up and down, and placed them on her abdomen.
When the sun rose, without Su Rui having to activate the technique, the purple gold gas surged in from all directions, rushed into Su Rui's body, and started running automatically.
Feeling the surge in the air, Liu Qingyun was secretly proud. He is worthy of being my apprentice. His qualifications don't have to be too good.
After breakfast, Su Rui and Liu Qingyun came to the study. Liu Qingyun threw Su Rui a copybook, asked her to copy it and told her to write a thousand characters every day, and left the study with her hands behind her back. Su Rui could only start her arduous journey of writing big characters. But when she discovered that writing big characters allowed her to absorb traces of purple-gold gas, she no longer complained about writing big characters. After all, mosquitoes are still flesh no matter how small they are.
